content:
One of my favorite Apple TV 4K features — the screensaver — may start getting audio in tvOS 27, according to the latest leaked information. Details below.

tvOS 27 code shows that at least one Apple TV screensaver will get audio options, with potential expansion to more in the future

October is widely expected to be a major month for Apple, with several new hardware and software products reportedly set to launch.

Among the rumored new products is a new Apple TV 4K, images of which have already surfaced in Apple code earlier.

Now on the software side, leaker pdfu has just published evidence found in the tvOS 27 code, showing that audio functionality is coming to Apple TV screensavers.

From the video above, you can see that the Snoopy screensaver has hidden options to enable or disable sound effects, or use a "reduce" setting.

The example of the Snoopy screensaver doesn't look like it would be too distracting, but I'm glad Apple plans to let users turn the sound off entirely.

Although pdfu hasn't yet found signs of audio support in other screensavers, there's a good chance Apple will expand this feature to more screensavers in the future.

What do you think about tvOS 27 potentially adding audio options to Apple TV screensavers? Let us know in the comments.
